title: batcher-recommendation-pipeline-safe-apply
creator: Priya Kumar
description: Design and implement a Batching Recommendation Pipeline that profiles live workloads, synthesizes heuristic-driven batch/caching parameter suggestions, continuously evaluates suggested configs via canary traffic, and performs automated safe apply/rollback. The pipeline should combine short-window telemetry (latency tail, per-batch sizes, request shape histograms) with longer-window stability signals (error rate, cost-per-token, KV cache hit rate) to recommend: target batch_size, max_latency_slo, coalescing window, prefix cache TTL, and per-model quantization hints. Critical objectives: minimize cost-per-successful-response while preserving 99th percentile latency SLOs and maintaining robust rollback behavior for any regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline ingests live telemetry from runtime and console metrics (per-route token counts, latency p95/p99, KV cache hit/miss, batch occupancy)
Recommendation engine outputs deterministic config suggestions in JSON format with confidence scores and rationale for each parameter
Safe-apply flow can deploy suggested configs to a canary subset (5% traffic) and evaluate against defined metrics for 30 minutes
Automated rollback triggers on metric regressions (>=10% p99 latency increase or >=3x error rate increase) and records a post-mortem artifact
Dashboard shows recent recommendations, apply status, and cost delta estimates for the last 7 days
steps: 1) Instrument runtime to expose per-request features: sequence length, model variant, KV cache usage, batch occupancy
2) Build initial ETL job to aggregate 1s/1m/1h telemetry windows and derive workload fingerprints
3) Implement heuristic scoring function combining cost and latency risk to produce candidate configs
4) Add canary rollout runner that applies a config to N routes with traffic percent split and collects telemetry
5) Implement rollback policy engine with thresholds and cooldowns; log decisions to audit trail
6) Create UI card in Console showing recommendations + one-click preview + apply/rollback history
7) Run safety experiments on staging with synthetic bursty traffic and evaluate false-positive rollback rates
